seoTitle: How to Block a Domain or Sender in Gmail (Workspace)
metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to blocking a spam domain or specific sender in Gmail through Google Workspace's admin and user-level settings.
intro: Unwanted emails from a spam domain or a persistent sender can clutter your inbox and pose a security risk. This guide covers how to block both at the individual Gmail level and through Google Workspace's broader settings.

steps.heading: Access Google Workspace
steps.body: Sign in to your account, or the Admin Console if you're managing blocking rules for your whole organization rather than just your own inbox.

steps.heading: Navigate to Gmail settings
steps.body: Open Gmail's settings menu to find the filters and blocked addresses section where sender-level blocking is managed.

steps.heading: Block a specific domain
steps.body: For organization-wide blocking, admins can set up email routing rules or filters in the Admin Console that reject mail from an entire domain.

steps.heading: Block an individual sender
steps.body: Within your own Gmail, use the block option on a message from that sender, or create a filter that automatically deletes or archives their emails.

steps.heading: Review and confirm the block
steps.body: Check your filter or blocked-sender list afterward to confirm the rule is active and test with a follow-up email if possible.

faq.question: Can I block an entire domain in Gmail without admin access?
faq.answer: As an individual user you can block specific senders, but blocking an entire domain organization-wide usually requires admin-level access through Google Workspace.

faq.question: Will blocking a sender delete their previous emails too?
faq.answer: No, blocking only affects future emails — messages already in your inbox stay unless you delete them separately.

faq.question: Can a blocked sender still email other people in my organization?
faq.answer: Yes, unless the block is applied organization-wide by an admin, a personal block only affects your own inbox.

faq.question: How do I unblock a domain or sender later?
faq.answer: You can remove the filter or blocked-sender entry from Gmail settings, or have an admin adjust the routing rule in the Admin Console.
